description: a disc of radius R 1.5 and height 1 whose outline is two half circles, so its side is two half cylinders that meet along rulings at the two tangent vertices (±R, 0) — the shape a hole's or a boss's rim has in the real parts, split where the file's vertices are — and the top rim's two half circles filleted at r 0.25 in one call: two plane-against-cylinder arcs, convex, which form a closed chain with no ends, the blend a torus of major radius R − r and minor r coaxial with the disc (two half tori or one whole, the ADR's choice), tangent to the top along a circle and to the side along a circle. The removed corner's section (1 − π/4) r² swept a full turn about the axis at R − r (10 − 3π) / (12 − 3π) by Pappus. Arris refuses it today as Unsupported (a circle curve against a plane): each half circle is an open arc
